spans.s: उत्थ a. (f. त्था) (used only as the last member of compounds) 1. Rising, springing up, R.xii.82, K.S.vi.59; 2. coming up or forth, standing up.
उत्थ a. (f. त्था) (used only as the last member of compounds) 1. Rising, springing up, R.xii.82, K.S.vi.59; 2. coming up or forth, standing up.

उत्थान m. 1. The act of rising or standing up, Bhartr.iii.9; 2. resurrection; 3. effort, exertion, लघु भवत्युत्थानयोग्यं वपुः Sak.ii.; 4. rise, origin, इंदुं नवोत्थानमिवेंदुमत्यै R.vi.31; 5. war, battle; 6. an army; 7. joy, pleasure; 8. awakening; 9. acquiring wealth or property, M.ix.215; 10. a courtyard.
उत्थापन n. 1. Causing to rise or come up; 2. exciting, instigating; 3. awakening; 4. vomiting.
उत्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Born, produced, sprung up; 2. endeavouring; 3. increasing, advancing; 4. risen or rising (as from a seat), अर्धाचिता सत्वरमुत्थितायाः R.vii.10, K.S.vii.60, Sis.i.15.
उत्थित a. (f. ता) 1. Born, produced, sprung up; 2. endeavouring; 3. increasing, advancing; 4. risen or rising (as from a seat), अर्धाचिता सत्वरमुत्थितायाः R.vii.10, K.S.vii.60, Sis.i.15.
उत्थित-अंगुलि m. the palm of the hand with the fingers extended.
